request: Let me mark important tasks and focus on those first

questions.ask: Should marking a task important just be a simple on/off flag (like a star), or do you want multiple levels such as High/Medium/Low priority?
questions.why: Determines whether we add a single 'important' checkbox/star (like the existing done checkbox) or a priority field with several options, which changes the UI controls and the data stored for each task.

questions.ask: When you say 'focus on those first', do you want important tasks to simply float to the top of the same list, or do you want a way to hide/filter out the non-important tasks so only important ones show?
questions.why: Decides whether we just re-sort the existing single list (important tasks first) or add a filter/toggle view that hides everything else.

questions.ask: Should you be able to mark a task important right when you create it, or only after it's already on the list (similar to how you check things off today)?
questions.why: Determines whether the 'Add a task' form needs a new important checkbox, or whether importance is only set afterward via a control on each existing task row.

findings.note: Tasks table currently only has id, title, done — no concept of importance/priority exists yet; a schema change (new column) is required.

API is minimal: GET /api/tasks (returns all, ordered by id), POST /api/tasks (title only), PATCH /api/tasks/:id (currently only updates 'done'). PATCH would need to accept an 'important' field, and GET/sort logic would need to change if we want important tasks to float to top or be filterable.

Client renders tasks as plain list items with a done checkbox; toggling done just PATCHes and reloads the full list. Adding importance would follow the same pattern (new checkbox/star per item, PATCH on change) plus possibly client-side or server-side sort/filter logic.

UI is a minimal single list with an add-task form; no existing sort/filter controls or priority styling (e.g., no star icon, no priority color coding) — these would need to be designed from scratch if requested.

reply: A separate view, not re-sorting the main list. Just on and off, no levels. And it should stay important even after it's done.

spec.summary: Add an on/off 'important' flag to tasks, toggleable from the main list, with a separate view that shows only important tasks (including completed ones).
acceptance: Each task in the main list has a toggle to mark/unmark it important, independent of its done state.
A separate view exists that lists only tasks currently marked important.
Marking a task done does not clear its important flag or remove it from the important view.
Toggling important updates the task via the API and persists across page reloads.
unchanged: The main list continues to show all tasks in existing (by-id) order — importance does not resort it.
Existing done-toggle behavior (checkbox, PATCH, reload) is unaffected.
The add-task form is unchanged — importance cannot be set at creation time, only toggled afterward, matching the pattern for done.
spec.check: Automated check creates a task, marks it important via PATCH /api/tasks/:id, confirms it appears in the important view, marks it done, confirms it remains in the important view and still shows important=true, and confirms the main list order/content is unaffected by importance.
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the important flag survives the done toggle (no code path clears 'important' when 'done' is set) and that the main list is filtered into a separate view rather than being re-sorted in place.
